items.title: Scan Nightclub Posters With Phone Camera to Unlock Secret Radio Stations
items.description: Aim Jason or Lucia's smartphone camera at illuminated DJ booth posters inside underground clubs like The Vault in Downtown Vice City to unlock hidden radio frequencies.

items.title: Apollo Aggregates Red Barn 4-Bag Trunk Restock Loop (~$55K/Run)
items.description: Load 4 duffel bags from the open red barn into a 4-slot trunk, manually save on Slot #15 and reload to restock, then fence contraband at Brian's Lockup (keypad 7700).

items.title: On-Foot Pseudo First-Person Camera Workaround (No Native FPS Toggle)
items.description: GTA 6 launched without an on-foot FPS toggle, but pairing closest third-person view with corner cover (R1/RB), phone lens, and Aim (L2/LT) + exit cover locks an eye-level POV.
items.summary: GTA 6 launched without an on-foot FPS toggle, but pairing closest third-person view with corner cover (R1/RB), phone lens, and Aim (L2/LT) + exit cover locks an eye-level POV.
items.controls: PS5: R1 + D-Pad Up -> L2 | Xbox: RB + D-Pad Up -> LT
